entries.failurePoint: After finding the 17K WAL file, agent ran PRAGMA/INSERT commands on the live DB that triggered auto-checkpoint, destroying the WAL; then tried to 'recreate the scenario' by guessing record values instead of recovering the actual WAL data
entries.rootCause: Agent misunderstood the task as recreating a WAL scenario rather than recovering specific unknown data from a corrupted WAL binary; it destroyed the source artifact via write operations and never produced recovered.json, so any output would be invented data failing the specific-data test
entries.generalMechanism: For forensic/recovery tasks, immediately back up all source artifacts read-only before any operation, and treat the task's data as unknown-to-be-extracted rather than reconstructable from the prompt's examples

entries.failurePoint: Writing verification.txt / final self-validation — agent tested only its own Python script and never confirmed verification.txt content matched the verifier's expected fields/format
entries.rootCause: Agent self-validated against its own interpretation (its script printed success) rather than the stated acceptance criteria; verification.txt content (likely truncated fingerprint or date/subject format) probably didn't match what the external checker parsed for
entries.generalMechanism: After producing output files, re-read each generated file and cross-check its exact contents against every literal requirement in the spec, rather than trusting a self-authored proxy script's success message

entries.failurePoint: Trajectory ends during image analysis phase; agent never wrote image.c, compiled it, or generated reconstructed.ppm
entries.rootCause: The attempt was truncated/ran out of runway while still exploring the reference image's structure. The write, compile, and similarity-verification todos all remained pending, so no candidate solution ever existed to be scored — an empty deliverable guarantees FAIL.
entries.generalMechanism: Enforce a runway/turn budget that reserves time to produce and test a minimal viable artifact before deep analysis; front-load a working end-to-end skeleton (write+compile+run a trivial image.c) early, then iteratively improve, so any truncation still leaves a scoreable deliverable.

entries.failurePoint: Trajectory ends mid-analysis while describing scheduler design; no implementation, no output files (plan_b1.jsonl/plan_b2.jsonl) written, no cost-model verification run.
entries.rootCause: The agent exhausted its runway (or was cut off) after only exploration and planning; it never reached the core deliverable of generating and validating the two batching plans against the required thresholds.
entries.generalMechanism: Enforce milestone-based progress tracking that prioritizes producing a minimal end-to-end deliverable early (write plans, run cost_model to check thresholds) before extended analysis, so budget is spent on verifiable artifacts rather than narration.
